meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: MUST USE for planning before coding when design uncertainty remains after discovery: ambiguous scope, competing decompositions, unclear boundaries, uncertain dependency ordering, architecture decisions, a vague 'just make it good / figure out what to build' brief, or any request to plan, interview, or break work down. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode, just make it good, figure out what to build.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编码前制定完整的开发计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手编码前先理清范围、依赖和架构。
copy.tagline_en: Create a complete work plan before coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to clarify scope, dependencies, and architecture before writing code.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先探索代码库，只问必须由你决定的问题，然后等你批准，最后写出一份完整的、无需再问你的工作计划。
howto.when: 当你提出模糊或大型需求（如“让登录更好”、“规划这个”），或要求“先规划再编码”、“采访我”时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一下这个新功能，先别写代码。
say.note: Claude 会开始探索并提问。

say.text: 采访我，然后制定一个工作计划。
say.note: Claude 会主动问你关键问题。

say.text: 先规划再编码，把登录模块重构一下。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first explores the codebase, asks only the questions you must decide, waits for your approval, then writes a complete work plan that requires no further interview.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you give a vague or large request (e.g., 'make auth better', 'plan this'), or ask to 'plan before coding', 'interview me', etc.

say_en.text: Plan this new feature for me, don't code yet.
say_en.note: Claude will start exploring and asking questions.

say_en.text: Interview me and then create a work plan.
say_en.note: Claude will actively ask you key questions.

say_en.text: Plan before coding, refactor the login module.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a refactoring plan.
